51587004.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human DC-SIGN CRD (264 to 399 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis
51587004.references_previous: Achilli, S.; Monteiro, J. T.; Serna, S.; Mayer-Lambertz, S.; Thépaut, M.; Le Roy, A.; et al. TETRALEC, artificial tetrameric lectins: a tool to screen ligand and pathogen interactions. Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2020, 21, 5290.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Binding Assay: The binding affinities of gly-C34s for N36 or DC-SIGN CRD were analyzed using a Biacore biosensor system (Biacore 3000, Biacore Co., Ltd.) based on SPR technology. Briefly, N36 or DC-SIGN CRD (expressed and purified according to the procedure described as reported40) was immobilized on a sensor chip (CM-5, research grade) using a standard primary amine-coupling protocol. Peptide or gly-C34 conjugates in PBS containing Tween 20 (0.05%, v/v) at graded concentrations (0.125 to 4 μM) were flowed over the surface of the sensor at a rate of 20 μL/min. C34 and Mannan were used as positive controls. The binding kinetic parameters were calculated using the Biacore evaluation software (version 4.1).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Binding of the conjugates to the gp41 N-peptide N36 (A) and the carbohydrate recognition domain (CRD) of the dendritic cell-specific intercellular adhesion molecule 3-grabbing nonintegrin (DC-SIGN) (B). N36 or the DC-SIGN CRD was immobilized on the surface of Biacore sensor chips. The analyte at the indicated concentration in running buffer (phosphate-buffered saline, pH 7.4) was poured over the surface. The Kd values were calculated using BIACore 3000 analysis software. Mannan (Mann) was used as a positive control in the DC-SIGN/gly-C34 binding assay (B). The calculated binding parameters of the other conjugates are provided in the Supporting Information (Tables S1 and S2).
